tool_version: Pinned IDA 9.5 ASM and Hex-Rays C; iced-x86 1.21.0, pefile 2024.8.26, Zig 0.13.0; ninth-round: Ghidra 12.2, Capstone 5.0.6
command: Decode original instructions at the pinned IDA addresses; reassemble with python verify.py <zedstwu.dll> <zig>. Run check-native-coverage.py NATIVE-350 --original <zedstwu.dll>.
scope: Legacy entries, original entry point, exports, all runtime anchors and the additional direct branch target at RVA 0x180c0; two copy entries, 128 import thunks and version resource checked independently. Fifth-round evidence includes four reassembled business exports and a cross-DLL data symbol. Ninth-round evidence covers both called hosts, their complete text, direct branches, external calls and RIP operands.
limitations: The remaining 119 entries and 44 indirect transfers retain their baseline records. Callee implementations, data values and type layouts, whole-DLL linking, unwind and Windows behavior are outside the two host checks.
